lede: County officials will get their first look at Colorado's new Low Energy and Carbon Code on Tuesday, a set of building standards that could change how structures get approved throughout San Miguel County. Otherwise it's a quiet week for government business, with most agendas still under wraps. The library's hosting everything from gardening camp to a free legal clinic, and there's a Livable Telluride kick-off party Wednesday.

notable.stake: New building codes could reshape construction approval processes countywide
